Cyrus’s MS Dhoni Impression Goes Hilariously Wrong! ft. Shantanu Anam | Cyrus Says
Welcome to Cyrus Says!
Cyrus Broacha attempts an MS Dhoni impression, Shantanu Anam challenges it, and somehow their office colleague Suresh becomes part of the comparison. What follows is a Dhoni mimicry battle that neither of them is willing to lose.
Actor, comedian and filmmaker Shantanu Anam joins Cyrus for Bollywood casting debates, cricket impressions and relentless podcast banter. They discuss Robert Pattinson as James Bond and make their picks for India’s 007—with Shah Rukh Khan leading Shantanu’s list.
